lemmas.primary_translation: to come into view / of a divine or supernatural being: to make oneself visible

examples.en: the village comes into view on the mountainside

definitions.text: om guddommelig eller overnaturlig vesen: gjøre seg synlig
definitions.translation: of a divine or supernatural being: to make oneself visible

examples.no: Den hellige ånd åpenbarte seg for disiplene
examples.en: the Holy Spirit appeared to the disciples
